policies.title: Points and invitation policies
policies.redemptionLifetime: A redemption barcode is valid for up to {{seconds}} seconds from issue. It may expire sooner if its reservation ends.
policies.redemptionRefresh: Refreshing a barcode does not spend more points or extend the reservation. When it expires, request a new barcode for the same reservation. Its card shows when the reservation ends.
policies.redemptionSharing: Show the current barcode to the cashier to apply the discount. Do not share or forward its screenshot. A gift-card claim code is separate from a points-redemption barcode.
policies.pointsLife: Each new batch of points expires {{months}} month after it is earned.
policies.pointsLife_plural: Each new batch of points expires {{months}} months after it is earned.
policies.pointsLife_0: Each batch of points has its own expiry date, shown in point history.
policies.pointsLife_1: Each new batch of points expires one month after it is earned.
policies.pointsLife_2: Each new batch of points expires two months after it is earned.
policies.pointsLife_3: Each new batch of points expires {{months}} months after it is earned.
policies.pointsLife_4: Each new batch of points expires {{months}} months after it is earned.
policies.pointsLife_5: Each new batch of points expires {{months}} months after it is earned.
policies.pointsDates: Your oldest points are used first. Purchases and point transfers do not extend their original expiry dates.
policies.unusedReturn: When an unused redemption is cancelled or a payment made with points is reversed, only points that are still valid return, with their original earning and expiry dates. Cancellation or return does not extend their life or restore expired points. Returned points may offset the purchase-point adjustment described below.
policies.returnReview: If the original point dates cannot be verified, the transaction needs review before points can be returned.
policies.referralReward: The inviter earns up to {{points}} points once for each new friend's first paid order, provided the conditions are met. The friend receives no referral points. Sharing a link or signing up alone earns no points.
policies.referralPayment: The first order must include an actual payment. A free order or an order paid entirely with points does not qualify for the referral reward.
policies.referralPhones: Both the inviter and friend must have Jordanian mobile numbers starting with {{prefix}}, and each must verify their number with a verification code.
policies.referralAttach: The friend must add one invite code before their first paid order. It cannot be changed afterwards. You cannot use your own code or a code belonging to an account with the same phone number.
policies.referralCorporate: Accounts with a standing discount, including corporate accounts, do not earn referral points.
policies.referralCap: Each inviter has a lifetime referral reward limit of {{points}} points. The final reward may be smaller than usual if less remains within that limit.
policies.referralNoReset: Spending points, point expiry, purchase refunds, account deletion and rejoining do not reset the referral reward limit.
policies.refundEarned: When a purchase is refunded, the points earned on the refunded portion are removed. If your point balance does not cover them, the remainder is settled from later point credits: purchase points, gifts and bonuses, incoming transfers, and points returned from unused redemptions.
policies.refundMoney: This is a points adjustment only. There is no cash fee or money payable, and nothing is deducted from the cash refund or your prepaid wallet balance.
policies.refundGifts: A purchase refund does not by itself reverse an eligible welcome gift or referral reward, or change their conditions or original amounts. Points credited from those rewards may offset points still owed from earlier refunded purchases.
policies.refundExpired: Purchase points proved to have expired before use, including points reserved for an unused redemption, are not reclaimed. Transactions without reliable original records require review.
